6 Tips for Preventing Hair Breakage this Winter

By Chinwe of Hair and Health

Winter can easily translate into hair breakage if you follow these tips:

1. Moisturize your hair with a deep conditioning treatment. This will help to protect your hair from becoming dry and damaged.
2. Try not to use heat styling tools on your hair.
3. If your hair is thinning, try to use less hair combs or brushes that have soft bristles.
4. Avoid using harsh chemicals in your hair. These can cause further damage to your hair.\hairstyle: A hairstyle is a way of arranging one’s hair .
